capabilities: chat about notes with optional memory-based retrieval of past notes
discover connections from the current note via Pagelet
draft articles and generate or edit images from note material
capture quick thoughts and view writing statistics
prepare and publish article drafts to Ghost
disambiguation: Not a general productivity or scheduling assistant; it is an AI chat and content tool that works on vault notes and external AI services.
extras: README follows an unreleased master build; the community-directory release may not yet include the described interface. AI usage costs depend on the configured provider, Memory is enabled by default after configuration, and older plugin/theme management tools are retired. Client is AGPL-3.0-only from 2.8.0.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat or assistant for querying vault content, retrieving relevant older notes, or drafting and generating content from them.

relations.evidence: Desktop graph popovers need Hover Editor
The desktop @blog2ghost workflow can prepare article drafts and media with your configured Ghost credentials
You can configure OpenAI, DashScope China/International, and compatible custom Chat services

summary: Open-source AI assistant that chats about your notes, retrieves related ones, drafts articles and images, and can publish to Ghost.
